name: Knitting Starter Guide
description: Teaches absolute beginners the essential knitting skills: long-tail cast-on, knit stitch, purl stitch, bind-off, and basic pattern reading. Includes a materials checklist, stitch-by-stitch technique descriptions, common mistake diagnosis, and a first-project recommendation (dishcloth or scarf). Use when the user wants to learn to knit, asks about casting on, knit and purl stitches, reading knitting patterns, or choosing a first project. Do NOT use for crochet techniques, advanced stitch patterns (cables, lace), or sewing and quilting.
